headline: FTC launches inquiry into OpenAI and Anthropic
standfirst: The government is investigating potential consumer risks involving top AI developers.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The FTC issued subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic regarding their AI safety practices.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The agency is investigating potential consumer harms stemming from these major AI companies.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This signals growing federal oversight into how rapidly evolving AI impacts the public.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: The results of the FTC investigation and any subsequent regulatory actions taken.

caption:
The Federal Trade Commission is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over safety concerns.

Regulators are digging into the inner workings of two of the biggest names in artificial intelligence. This probe focuses on how these companies manage potential harms to consumers. It marks a significant step in the government's effort to keep up with the fast-paced AI industry.
